SWILLM School project presentation

SWILLM

Swimwear and gear storefront

A website and server built for a school assignment.

Project brief

Build a website and server to submit to the teacher, using a swimming kit shop as the example.

Shared project conversation

Brand and style
SWILLM, with a clean, premium storefront.
Homepage cover
The owner’s own swimming photo.
Pricing
Nigerian naira (₦, NGN).
Checkout
Sample orders for the class demo.

Ten development phases

  1. Server and product data
  2. Homepage and swim photo cover
  3. Catalog and product categories
  4. Search and category filters
  5. Product details, sizes and colours
  1. Shopping bag
  2. Demo checkout and order confirmation
  3. Order storage and local order desk
  4. Mobile and accessibility pass
  5. Teacher handoff and setup guide

The product catalog

20 products, including goggles, trunks, swimsuits, caps, fins and earplugs.

Online reference photos illustrate the item types.

Finding the right swim kit

  • Browse a collection, filter by product type or search by keyword.
  • Compare designs and colours, then choose an available size.
  • Review the bag and adjust quantities before checkout.

Two-field checkout

Full nameEmail address

After submission, the shop shows the reference for the saved order.

Demo checkout collects no payment.

Orders and email

Live delivery to the shop owner’s inbox requires a Gmail App Password on the server.

  1. Save the order

    The Python server checks the items and subtotal, then saves the order locally.

  2. Queue the email

    The alert includes the order reference, customer contact and items.

  3. Check the order desk

    The owner can see saved orders and track whether Gmail accepted each alert.

Live demo

  1. Start the local server with Start SWILLM.cmd.
  2. Choose a product, add it to the bag and place a demo order.
  3. Find the order reference in the order desk.
Open the storefront

127.0.0.1:8000 is local to this computer. A public order link would require hosting the storefront and server.
